prompt: Create ONE wide LANDSCAPE 16:9 fine architectural ink-and-watercolour illustration on warm cream art paper. This is a new distinct candidate in the approved Artemis Atlantic Heritage Watercolour series, using the attached image as a STYLE AND BUILDING-FAMILY reference, not a scene to copy. Hand-drawn dark sepia nib, delicate precise cross-hatching, transparent layered watercolor washes, limestone cream/ochre, volcanic basalt grey, restrained bronze, natural greens, quiet Atlantic blue-grey. Airy unfinished vignette edges, sophisticated calm composition, soft natural light. No photorealism or computer 3D, no people, no text, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, amphorae, deeds or money. No exact parcel, approved architectural plan, guaranteed amenity or documentary project-progress claim. One landscape illustration only. A restrained conceptual stone threshold and a simple lime-plastered Spanish arch opening toward a leafy courtyard, a short basalt path receding through it. Composition evokes the beginning of an architectural project. No gates, keys, deeds, handshakes, paperwork, people or implied completed infrastructure. Very quiet warm-paper ink study with transparent watercolour.
rights_basis: New concept illustration from approved project style reference; public-use clearance remains pending
